structured.rankingRationale: CASP ranks first for association identity, exact dates, named resort, hotel accommodations, and public contact. NetOne and First Connect follow for verified recognition/incentive programmes with exact dates and hosted events. Nealey follows for an edition-specific hosted group with a published group-savings mechanism. The Moon Palace weddings have strong date/resort/group-block evidence but lower buyer accessibility and corporate fit. The Westin golf invitation is highly verified and hospitality-intensive, but more leisure/sports-led.

notesForDeepResearch: Validate organizer/PCO route and any overflow, staff, pre/post, or ancillary lodging before treating candidates as actionable current demand.
Investigate next-edition timing and sourcing windows; do not infer recurrence from one edition.
materialUncertainties: All nine candidates are committed to named competing resorts; none is current-edition open inventory.
Sources do not establish room-block size, peak rooms, attendance, or contracting authority except where group-block mechanisms are described.
No qualifying edition-specific commitment was found for Eden Roc Cap Cana, Margaritaville Island Reserve Cap Cana, or Tortuga Bay Puntacana.

result.text: Identified nine edition-specific future events in 2027–mid-2028 whose official or organizer pages name one of the specified competing resorts. All are venue-committed, so they are not treated as open current-edition inventory; the commercial thesis is targeted verification, ancillary/overflow investigation where evidenced, and future competitive capture. A verified Corales Puntacana Championship edition was flagged out because its named venue is Puntacana Resort & Club, which was not among the specified competitor resorts.
